action: Exact-source verification of NotificationMetaObject wire-shape capacity only.
result: At exact rmcp-v3.1.4 release commit 4a738b9dd99eaca418b614afa433a0cbdaf8d056, NotificationMetaObject is a serde-transparent wrapper around MetaObject. MetaObject wraps a JsonObject and its schema permits additionalProperties=true. NotificationMetaObject reserves io.modelcontextprotocol/subscriptionId and its own schema explicitly says extension keys are also allowed with additionalProperties=true. Therefore arbitrary server-minted continuation fields are representable in notification _meta at this exact model/type layer without inventing a private transport extension.
